prompt:
Use the attached approved runescribe master as the exact identity, palette, costume, rune pattern, proportions and sprite-art reference. It is the SAME character. Create a clean production animation sprite sheet, not a concept board. 6 frames in exactly 2 rows by 3 equal square cells, row-major order. Overall canvas aspect 3:2. Invisible cell grid only: no visible lines, labels, captions, numbers, text or watermark. Every cell contains exactly one complete pose.

DIRECTION LOCK: FRONT view, facing SOUTH toward the viewer in EVERY frame. Both ivory eyes visible. The scribe's staff stays on the viewer's RIGHT.

ACTION: Six in-place WALK phases, a real alternating gait, with the same body scale. For side views NEAR leg is closest to viewer, FAR leg is behind and darker; for front/back the anatomical legs alternate. 0 first leg forward contact, second leg back; 1 weight over first support leg, second passes beneath pelvis; 2 second leg reaches forward, first trails; 3 second leg forward contact and first back, the opposite of frame 0; 4 weight over second support leg, first passes under body; 5 first leg reaches forward toward frame 0, second trails. One foot on ground at all times; feet visibly alternate. The robe hem swings in response to steps but does not hide all foot movement. Free arm counter-swings; staff hand stays stable with modest natural sway. No root translation across the canvas.

FIXED REGISTRATION: each frame uses the same camera distance and identical body proportions. Root/stance midpoint at 50 percent of cell width and ground at 84 percent of cell height. Neutral top of hood at 14 percent of cell height. All extremities and the whole staff remain inside each cell with at least 8 percent empty margin, including during casting. Do not enlarge the face, shrink the whole body during attack, or change staff length. Make the six phases clear but restrained. No detached shadows, dust or extra objects. Pure genuinely transparent alpha outside each figure; retain the dark opaque cloth, dark hood and original bright glyph-like trim. Crisp restrained pixel-sprite aesthetic, no smooth gradients, no bloom, no painterly lighting and no thick new outline. All frames must match the master character. Preserve the reference's slender mature silhouette, not a chibi design. Export image with real transparency.
